text: The statement is inadmissible hearsay. It is an out-of-court accusation offered to prove the man failed to signal, and neither the excited-utterance nor the present-sense-impression exception can be laid, because no foundation shows the unidentified declarant personally perceived the lane change (FRE 602) and the declarant cannot be examined about it. The shared note's claim that every hearsay exception requires an identified declarant is overstated, since the rules don't say that outright, but the exceptions fail on the personal-knowledge foundation anyway. CONFIDENCE: 72
